title: Fizlet game spec
description: One file per game (games/<id>/spec.json): the single source the factory turns into the game repo scaffold, the site data (site/game.json), the family row and the Astro page engine brief. Facts only; measured numbers come from the build, not from here.

brand.description: Brand key in the family (domvirus, battlefield, …).

type.description: The game type the scaffold starts from (factory/game-types.mjs): HUD preset, pad scheme, bricks, budget and the rules stub; default shooter.

players.description: Seats in a match: 1 solo (default); 2+ adds fizlet/presence lockstep and the room card.

source.description: Where the number comes from (the size script that enforces it, or why it is provisional).

site.description: The game's site data, in the shape site-kit reads (site/game.json minus id/author/license). Key order is kept.

page.description: The marketing layer of the game's page, rendered into an Astro page engine brief.

type.description: Astro page engine page type in that site's engine.config.json.

image.description: Share image: absolute https URL, or site-relative (/og/x.png) so the page engine resolves it per target domain

slots.description: Optional site slots for the Astro page engine game preset (play, loop, controls and facts are always placed).

play.description: Label of the Play control (it starts the game; href #play).

genre.description: Catalog filter and VideoGame genre (e.g. Shooter, Tank, Defense).

playMode.description: schema.org GamePlayMode values; MultiPlayer gives the catalog's multiplayer badge.

players.description: Players in one match, as the catalog card shows it ("1", "1–2").

badges.description: Catalog badges the facts back. new: the release the page plays changed what players see (its whatsNew).

playHref.description: Where Play goes: #play (plays on the page, the default) or the board's own site.

links.description: More calls to action after Play (a second mode, the board's site).

poster.description: A real screenshot of the game (site-relative); also the share image unless page.image is set.

controls.description: Controls, for a page with no controls slot (boards).

strategy.description: Strategy for a game with real depth (STRATEGY block after TIPS): each item follows from the game rules in its repo; nothing invented.

whatsNew.description: From the game's CHANGELOG entry for the version the page plays; player-facing changes only.

prompt.description: The one-line prompt the spec was composed from (fe prompt). Facts still come from the game once built.

origin.description: The tiny game this game grew from (Stage 0 of playbooks/game-pipeline.md): written by fe game --from-anim.

anim.description: The Daily gallery entry id (fizlet site/gallery/entries/<id>.json).

picked.description: The day the owner picked it.

by.description: Whose tiny game it was: owner (the studio's own) or user:<GitHub login> (a submission).

bricks.description: The Fizlet bricks the tiny game used (the game adds the ones it keeps, with a size-ledger row).

teaser.description: The game's tiny game in the Daily gallery: its gallery piece, teaser and embed fallback. Required with origin.
